# Encyclopedia Britannica
> Fact-checked online encyclopedia with articles, biographies, media, and educational resources across history, science, geography, and culture.

Britannica publishes expert-edited reference content, topical explainers, biographies, timelines, quizzes, images, and videos for general readers, students, and educators.

## Encyclopedia Articles
- [Encyclopedia Home](https://www.britannica.com/): Main entry point to Britannica’s encyclopedia articles, topics, and featured editorial content.
- [Browse Articles A-Z](https://www.britannica.com/browse): Alphabetical index for discovering encyclopedia entries across all subjects.
- [Biographies](https://www.britannica.com/biographies): Directory of biography articles on historical figures, leaders, artists, and scientists.
- [Geography & Travel](https://www.britannica.com/topic/geography): Articles on places, countries, regions, maps, and geographic concepts.
- [Science](https://www.britannica.com/science): Reference content covering biology, physics, chemistry, Earth science, and more.
- [Technology](https://www.britannica.com/technology): Articles about inventions, engineering, computing, and applied sciences.
- [History](https://www.britannica.com/topic/history): Encyclopedia content on world history, civilizations, wars, and major events.
- [Literature](https://www.britannica.com/art/literature): Articles on literary works, authors, genres, and criticism.

## Subject Hubs
- [Politics, Law & Government](https://www.britannica.com/topic/politics-law-government): Reference articles on political systems, law, public policy, and institutions.
- [Philosophy & Religion](https://www.britannica.com/topic/philosophy-religion): Content on belief systems, philosophers, theology, and religious traditions.
- [Arts & Culture](https://www.britannica.com/art): Articles on visual arts, music, performance, architecture, and cultural history.
- [Sports & Recreation](https://www.britannica.com/sports): Entries on sports, athletes, competitions, and recreational activities.
- [Lifestyles & Social Issues](https://www.britannica.com/topic/lifestyles-social-issues): Coverage of society, customs, education, and contemporary social topics.
- [World Data](https://www.britannica.com/place): Place-based entries for countries, cities, regions, and geographic entities.

## Media and Interactive Reference
- [Images & Videos](https://www.britannica.com/media): Media library of educational images, illustrations, and videos.
- [ImageQuest](https://imagequest.britannica.com/): Curated image database for schools, libraries, and educational use.
- [This Day in History](https://www.britannica.com/on-this-day): Daily historical anniversaries, notable births, deaths, and events.
- [Quizzes](https://www.britannica.com/quiz/browse): Educational quizzes across history, science, geography, literature, and culture.
- [Lists](https://www.britannica.com/list/browse): Editorial list articles highlighting notable people, events, and themes.
- [Stories](https://www.britannica.com/stories): Short-form editorial explainers and topical features.
- [Demystified](https://www.britannica.com/story/browse): Concise explainers answering common questions on important topics.

## Students and Education
- [Britannica School](https://school.eb.com/): Age-appropriate encyclopedia and learning resources for K–12 students and teachers.
- [Britannica Kids](https://kids.britannica.com/): Child-friendly reference content, games, and learning materials for younger readers.
- [Britannica Academic](https://academic.eb.com/): Research-oriented reference platform for colleges, universities, and libraries.
- [Britannica Library](https://library.eb.com/): Public library reference portal with encyclopedia content and research tools.
- [Britannica Education](https://britannicaeducation.com/): Product information and resources for Britannica’s classroom and institutional offerings.
- [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/): Dictionary and language reference resource within Britannica’s broader educational portfolio.

## Teaching and Classroom Resources
- [Teaching Resources](https://britannicaeducation.com/teaching-resources/): Classroom materials, lesson support, and instructional resources for educators.
- [Professional Learning](https://britannicaeducation.com/professional-learning/): Training and development resources for teachers using Britannica products.
- [Primary Sources](https://primarysources.britannica.com/): Collections of historical documents and source materials for classroom research.
- [LaunchPacks Social Studies](https://britannicaeducation.com/launchpacks-social-studies/): Curated digital social studies resources aligned to classroom instruction.
- [Expedition: Learn!](https://britannicaeducation.com/expedition-learn/): Educational video and learning platform for classroom engagement.
- [Original Sources](https://corporate.britannica.com/product/original-sources/): Product information for Britannica’s historical source database.

## Current Events and Editorial Features
- [News and Analysis](https://www.britannica.com/news): Editorial coverage connecting current events to encyclopedia context.
- [ProCon](https://www.procon.org/): Nonpartisan issue overviews presenting arguments for and against debated topics.
- [Saving Earth](https://www.britannica.com/explore/savingearth): Environmental stories and explainers on climate, conservation, and sustainability.
- [100 Women](https://www.britannica.com/explore/100women): Biographies and stories highlighting influential women across history and fields.
- [Biographies Browse](https://www.britannica.com/biographies/browse): Browseable collection of biography entries and featured people.
- [Featured Stories](https://www.britannica.com/stories/browse): Archive of editorial stories and topical features.

## Games and Engagement
- [Games](https://www.britannica.com/games): Interactive educational games and puzzles based on knowledge and vocabulary.
- [Britannica Games Home](https://games.britannica.com/): Dedicated games portal with word, trivia, and logic-based activities.
- [Quordle](https://www.britannica.com/games/quordle): Daily word puzzle challenging players to solve four words at once.
- [Octordle](https://www.britannica.com/games/octordle): Word puzzle game where players solve eight words simultaneously.
- [Crossword](https://www.britannica.com/games/crossword): Crossword puzzle experience tied to Britannica’s games offering.
- [Word Search](https://www.britannica.com/games/word-search): Vocabulary-focused word search puzzle for casual educational play.

## Corporate and Product Information
- [Britannica Corporate](https://corporate.britannica.com/): Company information, products, partnerships, and organizational updates.
- [About Britannica](https://corporate.britannica.com/about/): Overview of Britannica’s mission, history, and educational focus.
- [Products](https://corporate.britannica.com/products/): Catalog of Britannica products for education, reference, and institutional use.
- [Careers](https://corporate.britannica.com/careers/): Employment opportunities and workplace information at Britannica.
- [Press Room](https://corporate.britannica.com/press/): Press releases, announcements, and media resources.
- [Contact](https://corporate.britannica.com/contact/): Corporate contact information for inquiries and partnerships.

## Help and Account
- [Support](https://support.britannica.com/): Help center for subscriptions, account access, and product support.
- [Subscription Information](https://support.britannica.com/hc/en-us/categories/360001186472-Subscription): Help articles about plans, billing, and subscription management.
- [Technical Support](https://support.britannica.com/hc/en-us/categories/360001186492-Technical-Support): Troubleshooting guidance for access and technical issues.
- [Sign In](https://www.britannica.com/account/login): Account login for Britannica users and subscribers.
- [Account](https://www.britannica.com/account): User account area for managing profile and subscription access.
- [Contact Support](https://support.britannica.com/hc/en-us): Main support portal for browsing help topics and submitting requests.
